description: This file defines classes and methods for CRM segmentation in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including segmentation rules and criteria evaluation.

classes.name: crm_segmentation
classes.description: Defines CRM segmentation logic, including processing and rule management.

classes.name: crm_segmentation_line
classes.description: Defines individual segmentation rules and criteria evaluation.

methods.name: process_continue
methods.description: Processes segmentation continuation, applying rules to partners.

methods.name: process_stop
methods.description: Stops segmentation process, setting status to 'not running'.

methods.name: process_start
methods.description: Starts segmentation process, setting status to 'running'.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Evaluates if a partner meets the segmentation criteria based on rules.
